description: MongoDB Detail — deeper serverStatus/dbStats/replSet metrics from percona/mongodb_exporter (diagnosticdata, dbstats, replicasetstatus collectors) than mongodb-overview.json. Complements it, does not replace it.

panels.description: Rate of database operations by type (serverStatus.opcounters).
panels.title: Op Counters (rate)

panels.description: rate(latency)/rate(ops) per operation type (serverStatus.opLatencies). Latency unit from Mongo is microseconds.
panels.title: Average Op Latency

panels.description: serverStatus.mem — resident/virtual, reported by Mongo in MB.
panels.title: Memory Usage
WiredTiger Cache (verify metric names against live Prometheus before trusting)

panels.description: BEST-EFFORT: percona/mongodb_exporter field names for nested WiredTiger cache stats were not verified live (Prometheus was unreachable while building this dashboard). Check via Prometheus label browser (label __name__, filter mongodb_ss_wt_cache) and fix the expr below if names differ.
panels.title: Cache Used vs Configured

panels.description: BEST-EFFORT metric names — verify against live Prometheus.
panels.title: Cache Read/Write Throughput

panels.description: serverStatus.asserts — a rising rate (especially "warning"/"msg") usually signals driver/query problems worth investigating.
panels.title: Assert Rate by Type

panels.description: 1 = healthy. Per-member, joined on rs_nm/name label exposed by the replicasetstatus collector.
panels.title: Replica Set Member Health

panels.description: Numeric replica set member state code (1=PRIMARY, 2=SECONDARY, ...).
panels.title: Replica Set Member State

panels.description: App-side MongoDB driver connection pool (com.mongodb.driver metrics via Micrometer) — the Mongo equivalent of HikariCP active/idle/pending.
panels.title: App Driver Pool (checked out vs size)

panels.description: Rate of the app failing to check out a connection from the driver pool — a rising rate means the pool is undersized for current load.
panels.title: Driver Pool Checkout Failures (rate)

panels.description: Average command latency as observed by the app driver (com.mongodb.driver.commands) — complements server-side opLatencies with the client-perceived cost, including network round-trip.
panels.title: App-observed Command Latency (driver, avg)

panels.description: Per-collection time spent in reads/writes/locks (serverStatus top command via --collector.topmetrics) — pinpoints which collection is actually driving load, unlike the aggregate Op Counters panel.
panels.title: Top Collections by Total Op Time (rate)

panels.description: extra_info.page_faults — a rising rate means the working set no longer fits in the WiredTiger cache and MongoDB is hitting disk, a leading indicator of latency spikes.
panels.title: WiredTiger Page Faults (rate)

title: MongoDB Detail
